testcase.name: Scenario: Update unavailable physical properties for a solid body: tmp/obk-bdd-gate-refresh/features/application/body-properties/body-properties.feature:5:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Update unavailable physical properties for a solid body ✔ Given a part containing one visible solid body is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the body's physical properties are unavailable in the current session ✔ When the user right-clicks the body in the model browser ✔ And the user chooses Properties ✔ Then the Body Properties dialog opens with the body name ✔ And mass, area, volume, and the X, Y, and Z coordinates of the center of gravity show N/A ✔ And the dialog displays a body appearance selector and OK and Cancel buttons ✔ When the user chooses Update ✔ Then mass, area, volume, and the center of gravity coordinates display calculated values ✔ And the solid remains highlighted behind the dialog ✔ When the user chooses Cancel ✔ Then the dialog closes ✔ And the solid remains visible ✔ When the user reopens Body Properties for the same body in the same session ✔ Then the calculated physical properties remain displayed ✔ When the user chooses Cancel ✔ Then the dialog closes
